en.title: P99 0 ms Autocomplete for 240 Million Domain Names
en.hook: An architectural breakdown of building a sub-millisecond autocomplete engine across 240M domain names.
key_takeaways: Achieved sub-millisecond (P99 0 ms) autocomplete performance across a massive 240 million domain dataset.
Leveraged compact, cache-friendly in-memory index structures (e.g., Tries) to optimize memory and CPU cycles.
Demonstrated practical engineering techniques for scaling real-time string search without heavy external engine clusters.
